name: Connect 4 (Rust engine + WASM web)
install: rustup default stable && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.128 --locked && (cd web && npm ci) && ./scripts/build-wasm.sh

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Connect 4 web UI on http://localhost:5173/ (loads the WASM solver).
